correctness.rationale: For dot u=0,dot z=sum_{edge}u_i u_j, F_h is exact and designed G_h scales u by 1+delta. With C_S(u) the cut quadratic, direct evaluation yields F-S=(-delta Q_Su,h C_S(u)) and F-H=(-delta Q_Su,0). Subtract old/new first-time-point defect at u=(1+delta)1 and u=1 to get errors (-delta^2 1_Sc,h(2delta+delta^2)b_G(S)) and (-delta^2 1_Sc,0). Orthogonal coordinate and scalar parts imply exact squared gap. At h=1 minimizing squared error over |S|=n/2 is precisely minimum bisection; NP membership and the standard min-bisection hardness premise yield NP-completeness, while cardinality-indexed rooted forest dynamic programming yields polynomial optimization. Independent rational direct propagation passed 240 test cases. Only two coarse intervals/one correction and coordinate projectors are covered.
